subject: Deal line-item sanitization — please verify line items & probabilities
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Ravi Patel <ravi@acuity.io>, pipeline@acuity.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deal line-item sanitization — please verify line items & probabilities

Hi Ravi / Acuity team —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finance is working the forecast and we spotted a few line-item and probability inconsistencies on ACU-4821 that we need to lock before EOM. Quick asks so we can keep this deal in the July commit: 

1) Please confirm the canonical product/SKU for the two line items in the attached CSV (rows 3 and 7). One is listed as "Core Inference - Standard" and another as "Core Infer - std" which looks like a duplicate.
2) Confirm committed ARR amounts for each line (total per invoice schedule) — the CSV has weekly estimates but we need contract-level amounts for forecasting.
3) Update next-step and owner for the renewal cadence (who will run the pilot success review).
4) Recommend an objective probability (60/80/95) tied to the current contract milestones — if you prefer we can propose the probability mapping.

If you can return the cleaned CSV by EOD Friday (2028-07-21 PDT) that would keep this in July numbers. I attached the export we pulled from CRM and a copy of the RFP clarifications for reference.

Best,
Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference

Attachments: Acuity_deal_lines_2028-07-19.csv (text/csv), RFP-scope-clarifications.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ravi Patel <ravi@acuity.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, pipeline@acuity.io
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-20 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal line-item sanitization — please verify line items & probabilities

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the note and the CSV. Apologies for the messy export — that duplicate SKU is our mistake (data entry difference between sales and the procurement sheet). We've attached an updated CSV with the normalized SKU column and the contract-level amounts filled in.

Quick clarifications from our side:
- Row 3 (Core Inference Standard) should be SKU: ACU-CI-STD, amount $120,000 (annual).
- Row 7 (the mis-typed entry) is a duplicate and should be merged into row 3 for forecasting.
- Pilot review owner will be myself (ravi@acuity.io), next step = "Pilot success review (30d)".
- For probability we recommend 70% today (pilot scheduled, exec approval pending). If Redwood needs a conservative mapping for commit we can accept 60% to match your internal rules.

Attached: Acuity_deal_lines_2028-07-20-clean.csv

Let us know if you want us to update HubSpot directly or prefer Redwood to push the changes into CRM.

Regards,
Ravi
Ravi Patel
Director of Cloud Partnerships | Acuity Systems

Attachments: Acuity_deal_lines_2028-07-20-clean.csv

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Ravi Patel <ravi@acuity.io>
Date: 2028-07-20 13:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Deal line-item sanitization — please verify line items & probabilities

Kim / team —

Thanks Ravi — the cleaned CSV is helpful. Two internal notes before we push: 
- I will merge the duplicate and set SKU = ACU-CI-STD.
- For forecast commit mapping we normally map a pilot-complete milestone to 60% until exec approval; given Ravi's exec approval is pending we should mark this at 60% in the commit so it doesn't artificially inflate commit.
- Marissa, can you please update HubSpot: replace the two line items with a single product ACU-CI-STD, set ARR = $120,000, owner = Ravi Patel, next_step = "Pilot success review (30d)", probability = 60%. I'll assign the CR to you.

Marissa: if you want Ravi to update their side and we do a quick verification, either works — just need the cleaned record in CRM before EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

Quick nudge —

Marissa / Ben: status on the CRM update? We still show two separate line items in the commit view; if it's not updated by COB I'll move this to the August pipeline (per finance request).

Ravi: thanks again for the cleaned file. If you can confirm one last time that your procurement/legal signature milestone remains on track for next week, we'll keep the 60% mapping for commit.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Kim
